issues.evidence: ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ is a single locked compound (法門 = Skt. dharmaparyāya). Prefixing 教法 renders ཆོས་ a second time and reads as 'the Dharma-gate of the teaching'. Bo-vasubandhu 2-91 uses ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་འདི་ as one term.

ཕུང་པོ་ལྷག་མ་མེད་པའི་མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པའི་དབྱིངས་ is 'the realm of nirvāṇa without remainder of the aggregates'; the locked rendering 無餘涅槃 already contains the aggregates. Adding a separate '蘊的' is awkward and misparses the compound (Skt. anupadhiśeṣe nirvāṇadhātau).

issues.span: 無上正等菩提——阿耨多羅三藐三菩提
issues.evidence: The Tibetan has one object, བླ་ན་མེད་པ་ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་བྱང་ཆུབ་ (locked: 阿耨多羅三藐三菩提). The translation renders it twice ('無上正等菩提' and '阿耨多羅三藐三菩提'), so it reads as two items or an inserted gloss; Sanskrit has the single anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim.

issues.evidence: The Tibetan epithet is དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ་ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས, three titles (Tathāgata, arhat, perfectly complete Buddha; Skt. tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena). སངས་རྒྱས is part of the third title, already covered by 正等覺者; listing 佛 separately yields a fourth epithet (cf. 7-28 and 8-100, which use 正等覺者 alone).
ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་སྤྱན is the locked compound 慧眼; 般若 is the locked rendering of the bare word ཤེས་རབ and is not to be added in front of 慧眼, making a redundant doubled rendering.

ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྤྱན is the locked compound 法眼. Adding 教法 (the locked rendering of bare ཆོས་) reads it as an eye of the doctrine or teaching. The commentaries define it differently: Kamalaśīla 3-184 'ཆོས་ཙམ་གྱི་ཡུལ་ལ་ནི་ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྤྱན' (the eye for the object that is mere phenomena); Vasubandhu 2-112 says it knows what is designated as dharmas and persons.
